inferred_requirements.title: HIPAA Safe Harbor Direct Identifier Stripping
inferred_requirements.description: The export pipeline must identify and remove all 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor direct identifiers from source records prior to downstream analytics ingestion.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly stated in the user prompt to strip 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor direct identifiers before analytics ingestion.

inferred_requirements.title: Deterministic De-identification and Cryptographic Hashing for Entity Linkage
inferred_requirements.description: If longitudinal analytics require tracking patient cohorts across pipeline runs without exposing raw direct identifiers, unique patient identifiers must be pseudonymized using a salted cryptographic hash function (e.g., HMAC-SHA256).
inferred_requirements.provenance: HIPAA Privacy Rule § 164.514(b) Expert Determination / Re-identification Risk Mitigation
inferred_requirements.justification:
Why 1: Simply stripping names and IDs breaks longitudinal analytics capability.
Why 2: Applying a cryptographically secure pseudonymous identifier generation method maintains analytical utility while preventing raw identifier exposure.
Why 3: The transform mechanism must never store raw keys alongside the output dataset to ensure zero-knowledge de-identification invariants are upheld.

inferred_requirements.title: Unspecified Storage Systems and Ingestion Formats
inferred_requirements.description: The specific source database engines, intermediate streaming/batch storage formats (e.g., Parquet, CSV, JSON), and target analytics data warehouse platforms are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt does not specify the technical storage layer, cloud environment, or analytics platform destination.

inferred_requirements.title: Unspecified Scheduling and Orchestration Framework
inferred_requirements.description: The execution frequency, orchestration tool (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Cron), and pipeline trigger mechanism are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt specifies the export transformation action but provides no execution cadence or orchestration toolchain requirements.
